subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack agents enumerate every conversation visible to their token, or should `channel-list` be separately gated and filtered to OpenClaw-authorized channels while `channel-info` remains target-scoped?
rationale: Targeted metadata lookup and workspace-wide enumeration have materially different disclosure and permission boundaries, so code structure alone cannot determine the intended product policy.

options.title: Scoped lookup and filtered listing
options.body: Expose target-scoped `channel-info`, then make `channel-list` separately opt-in and return only conversations allowed by OpenClaw channel policy.

options.title: Shared discovery gate
options.body: Enable both actions under one existing discovery gate and explicitly document that listing may enumerate every conversation visible to the selected Slack token.

options.title: Land lookup only
options.body: Implement `channel-info` now and track workspace enumeration separately after its access-policy and token-scope behavior is decided.

recommendation.title: Scoped lookup and filtered listing
recommendation.body: Expose target-scoped `channel-info`, then make `channel-list` separately opt-in and return only conversations allowed by OpenClaw channel policy.
